---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
shortened_years <- c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020)

# Aggregate season totals and rates once so plot tweaks don't redo the data work
hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  as_tibble() |>
  summarize(
    total_hr = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_g = sum(G),
    hr_per_game = total_hr / total_g,
    .by = yearID
  ) |>
  mutate(
    season_type = if_else(
      yearID %in% shortened_years,
      "Shortened season",
      "Full season"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(season_type)
```

```{r}
hr_by_season |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr_per_game)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(color = season_type), size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Full season" = "steelblue", "Shortened season" = "firebrick")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Major League Home Runs per Game Over Time",
    subtitle = "Shortened seasons blend right into surrounding eras once measured as a per-game rate",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs per Team-Game",
    color = "Schedule",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database (Shortened: 1918–19, 1981, 1994–95, 2020)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
Teams |>
  as_tibble() |>
  # Keep the normal 2019 season and the three shortened seasons
  filter(yearID %in% c(1981, 1994, 2019, 2020)) |>
  summarize(
    total_hr = sum(HR),
    total_g = sum(G),
    # Divide total home runs by team-games to get per-team-per-game rate
    hr_per_game = total_hr / total_g,
    .by = yearID
  ) |>
  arrange(yearID) |>
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 2,
    col.names = c("Season", "Total Home Runs", "Total Team-Games", "HR per Team-Game")
  )
```
